static_traits.name: Lin Peiqi
static_traits.family_status: Living with a strict father and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Has a close friend but has not yet shared financial worries with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no previous similar psychological problems or counseling experience
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with good logic, able to cooperate in exploration; emotions slightly tense and worried

basic_info.main_problem: I have always worried about money and feel I will never earn enough. This worry appeared when I started my first job and I believe it may be related to my family's financial difficulties; now it worsens whenever I think about money or expenses, affecting my sleep and studies.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent money worries and the feeling of never earning enough have affected my daily life and mental health, so I came to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: The family of origin has long been financially strained, and the father held a strict attitude toward money; growing up in such a family atmosphere, the client witnessed the stress and consequences of 'not having enough money' and gradually formed high vigilance toward money and security.
After obtaining the first job, income was low, and from then on the client began to persistently worry about future financial stability, fearing that no matter what they do they will not earn enough.

core_beliefs: I cannot secure my own financial security
我是注定在经济上失败的

special_situations.event: Facing low pay and work pressure at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my first job does not earn enough, there will be no improvement in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling down on saving and budgeting, constantly calculating expenses to seek a sense of security
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always have no money; I will be trapped by finances

special_situations.event: Seeing a pay slip / salary arriving in the account
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My current income level equals the ceiling of my future income
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extrapolating long-term hardship from a single paycheck level, repeatedly recalculating expenses

special_situations.event: 需要花钱支付日常开销时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I spend money now it is irresponsible; I will be poorer in the future
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not spend any money, or it will get worse

special_situations.event: Thinking of the family's past financial hardship and father's strict attitude toward money
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my family was once in financial straits, I will also repeat the same fate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Internalizes the father's money rules as the sole standard, with continuous self-vigilance and restraint
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My future will also be financially strained like my family's

core_conflict.wish: Longs for predictable financial security and to be understood and supported
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of experiencing poverty and scarcity again, and of being blamed or controlled
defense_goal: Reducing uncertainty through control and restraint
Avoiding exposing vulnerability to others to avoid being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A cautious young person who needs to stay alert at all times
object_relations.object_representation: A strict, judgmental, and controlling father/significant other

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to express money-related emotions or seek others' support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If expressing worries will be seen as not independent or lead to blame (like the father's standards)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Glosses over emotions with brief, factual descriptions, avoids discussing feelings in depth, and quickly shifts to plans and details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing future uncertainty and career paths
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Must control risk with rational analysis, otherwise will lose control and be hurt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Extensively uses the tone of data, hypotheses, and logical deduction, weakening personal emotional vocabulary and subjective experience.

manifestations: Strong anxiety in the face of future career and financial uncertainty
Takes 'the future must be secured now' as a self-requirement, emphasizing complete personal responsibility for outcomes
Tries to counter uncertainty through strict budgeting and control
outcomes: 持续性担忧与灾难化思维
Sleep is impaired, studies decline, and subjective well-being decreases

manifestations: Although there are close friends, has never shared financial worries
Tends to bear money anxiety alone, reducing outside support
outcomes: Emotional support is lacking; anxiety is hard to empathize with and buffer

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalized the father's strict rules about money, treating 'must save / should not spend' as the only standard
Equating the low salary of the first job with a verdict on self-worth and future development

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When facing anxiety, does not seek help from friends, instead turning to self-harshness and self-control (excessive budgeting, suppressing spending)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly self-examines whether spending is 'appropriate', worrying about being evaluated and not daring to express needs

positive_force: Having proactive budgeting and saving behavior, having basic self-management ability
Superiors mention that promotion opportunities exist; a career development path is visible
Willing to seek help and start counseling, positive attitude, willing to engage in self-monitoring
Has the willingness and action plans to improve skills (exploring promotion, learning skills)
Having one close friend who can be contacted (potential social support resource)
negative_force: The family of origin's long-term financial straits and the father's strict views on money have been internalized as high-pressure beliefs
Marked cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, and fortune-telling
Excessive worry leads to impaired sleep and academic decline, forming a negative cycle
Avoids seeking support, internalizes stress, and bears it alone
Equates the current low salary with a lifetime development ceiling, lacking a flexible perspective on the growth path

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and catastrophizing thinking around money
antecedent: Seeing a pay slip / salary arriving in the account
需要花钱支付日常开销
Thinking about future career and financial stability
target_behavior.core_reason: Financial hardship in the family of origin and the father's strict views on money cause the client to overgeneralize the current low pay into a long-term predicament and make catastrophic predictions about the future.
target_behavior.function: Gains a short-term sense of safety through excessive worry and control, escaping the anxiety brought by uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep is impaired, academic performance declines, and overall well-being drops
